utterance: For my last screening question, tell me about a time you spoke up for a patient whose needs had been overlooked.

A patient who was hard of hearing kept getting updates while people were facing the computer. I asked the team to face her when they spoke and made sure she could see the plan in writing. Before I left, she walked me through it in her own words.
You changed how the team gave updates and checked that the plan made sense to her. What questions do you have about the position?
No, I think we've covered everything I wanted to ask. Thanks for taking the time.
